data_description.lamp_profile: Override auto-detection when colour mode or spectrum is wrong. Plant uses RGB translated to Rose / Blue / Cold White / Pure White / Warm White.
data_description.ping_interval: How often Home Assistant reads from the light to keep the BLE connection alive. Lower values improve reliability at the cost of slightly more radio traffic. Default: 10 s.
data_description.active_time: How long to keep an active BLE GATT session after the last command. The Reachable sensor still shows the lamp if it is advertising. Default: 120 s.
